svg.title: The agricultural share of employment fell in all six regions covered here, at different speeds
svg.desc: Small multiples: The agricultural share of employment fell in all six regions covered here, at different speeds: Sub-Saharan Africa: 60.23% in 1991, 59.77% in 2000, 56.06% in 2010, 52.13% in 2020, 49.34% in 2025; South Asia: 63.15% in 1991, 59.81% in 2000, 50.08% in 2010, 43.94% in 2020, 41.50% in 2025; East Asia and Pacific: 52.79% in 1991, 45.01% in 2000, 34.52% in 2010, 23.76% in 2020, 21.65% in 2025; Latin America and the Caribbean: 21.14% in 1991, 18.34% in 2000, 15.12% in 2010, 14.75% in 2020, 12.72% in 2025; Europe and Central Asia: 15.49% in 1991, 13.90% in 2000, 9.67% in 2010, 7.87% in 2020, 6.67% in 2025; North America: 2.99% in 1991, 2.41% in 2000, 1.84% in 2010, 1.73% in 2020, 1.48% in 2025.
